script: Did you know Krishna once lifted a mountain to protect his village? According to legend, young Krishna lived in the village of Vrindavan. One day, the villagers prepared to worship Lord Indra, the god of rain. But Krishna asked, 'Why not worship Govardhan Hill, which gives us grass, water, and shelter?' The villagers agreed, angering Indra. Furious, Indra sent a storm, flooding the village. But Krishna, calm and composed, lifted the entire Govardhan Hill on his little finger! The villagers took shelter under the hill, safe from the storm. For seven days, Krishna held the hill, showing his divine power. Indra, realizing his mistake, stopped the storm and sought forgiveness. This story teaches us about courage and wisdom. Krishna's childhood was full of such inspiring tales.
